description: "Which ASN owns [IP]" / "what network is this address on" / "who is the upstream provider" — autonomous system lookup via HackerTarget, returning the ASN, the announced prefix (network range) and the network's name for an address, plus owner_domain (from PeeringDB or the registry contact, with its source; null with a reason when none states one). Use to attribute an address to a hosting provider, ISP or cloud region. For "which company owns this IP" call rdap_ip, the registry source for ownership.

target.description: IPv4 address or ASN, e.g. "1.1.1.1" or "AS13335".
